newsitem.title: ITALY: CYCLING-ZABEL WINS MILAN-SAN REMO CLASSIC.
newsitem.headline: CYCLING-ZABEL WINS MILAN-SAN REMO CLASSIC.

text.p: Germany's Erik Zabel won the 294-km Milan to San Remo cycling classic on Saturday in a sprint finish in which world champion Johan Museeuw and world number one Laurent Jalabert were involved in a bad crash.
As Zabel snatched victory in this opening round of the World Cup, Jalabert, the victim of an horrendous crash in the 1994 Tour de France, appeared to ride into Museeuw, bringing down several riders.
Among the fallers was British Olympic bronze medallist Max Sciandri, who was soon on his feet. But Belgium's Museeuw, the Cup holder, was led away grimacing in pain from a shoulder injury.
Frenchman Jalabert was driven away in an ambulance, bringing back memories of his collision with a gendarme at Armentieres three years ago, which put him out for the rest of the season.
Italians Alberto Elli and Biagio Conte were second and third in the same time as the winner -- six hours 57 minutes 47 seconds.
